entries.title: Diamond Mining Depth
entries.content: Diamonds spawn most frequently at Y-level -59 in Minecraft 1.18+. Strip mining at this level with a branch every 2 blocks is the most efficient method.

entries.title: Nether Portal Linking
entries.content: Nether portals link at an 8:1 ratio. Build a portal in the Nether at X/8 and Z/8 of your Overworld coordinates to create a fast travel network.

entries.title: Shield Timing
entries.content: Raise your shield just before a hit lands. Shields block 100% of melee damage and most projectiles. Axes can disable shields for 5 seconds.

entries.title: Enderman Fighting
entries.content: Build a 2-block-high shelter and attack Endermen from inside. They cannot enter and will take damage. Alternatively, wear a carved pumpkin to prevent aggro.

entries.title: Enchanting Optimization
entries.content: Surround an enchanting table with 15 bookshelves (one block away, one block high) for maximum level 30 enchantments. Leave one block open for access.

entries.title: Iron Farm Basics
entries.content: Iron golems spawn when 3+ villagers with beds are scared by a zombie. Build a simple iron farm by trapping a zombie near villagers with beds above a kill chamber.

entries.title: First Night Survival
entries.content: Punch trees for wood, craft a wooden pickaxe, mine stone, craft stone tools. Get at least 3 wool from sheep for a bed before nightfall. Place bed and sleep to skip night.

entries.title: Wither Strategy
entries.content: Spawn the Wither underground in a long 1x2 tunnel. The bedrock ceiling in the Nether is ideal. Use Smite V sword and strength potions. Keep milk buckets for wither effect.

entries.title: Redstone Basics
entries.content: Redstone signal travels 15 blocks. Use repeaters to extend range. Comparators read container fullness. Observers detect block changes. Pistons push up to 12 blocks.

entries.title: XP Farming
entries.content: The fastest XP farm is an Enderman farm on the End main island. Use a 43-block-high platform with a 2-block-high gap. Endermen teleport up and fall to 1 HP for easy kills.

entries.title: Food Tier List
entries.content: Golden carrots give the best saturation. Steak and cooked porkchop give 8 hunger points. Suspicious stew can give saturation effect. Bread is easy early-game food from wheat.

entries.title: Ender Dragon Fight
entries.content: Destroy End crystals on obsidian pillars first (bow or climb). Use beds to deal massive damage when the dragon perches on the fountain. Bring slow falling potions.

entries.title: Villager Trading
entries.content: Cure zombie villagers for massive discounts. Lock trades by having villagers use their workstation. Librarians can sell any enchanted book — keep breaking and replacing lecterns.

entries.title: Elytra Movement
entries.content: Launch with firework rockets for speed boost. Aim slightly downward to gain speed, then pull up to glide. Optimal angle is about 15 degrees below horizontal for distance.

entries.title: Mining Safety
entries.content: Always carry a water bucket when mining. It extinguishes fire, creates obsidian over lava, and breaks falls. Never dig straight down — dig a 2x1 staircase instead.

entries.title: Mob Spawning Rules
entries.content: Hostile mobs spawn in light level 0 on solid blocks. They spawn 24-128 blocks from the player. Light up caves and surfaces within 128 blocks of your base to prevent spawns.

entries.title: Nether Fortress Finding
entries.content: Nether fortresses generate in strips along the Z axis. Travel east or west (X axis) to find them. They contain blaze spawners needed for Eyes of Ender.

entries.title: Beacon Powers
entries.content: Beacons need a pyramid of iron/gold/diamond/emerald/netherite blocks. A full 4-layer pyramid gives Speed, Haste, Resistance, Jump Boost, and Strength in a 50-block radius.

entries.title: PvP Sword Combos
entries.content: Wait for the attack cooldown to reset before swinging again. Sprint-hit for knockback. Critical hits deal 50% more damage — fall while attacking. Axes deal more damage but are slower.

entries.title: Potion Brewing
entries.content: Brew awkward potions first (nether wart + water bottles). Add blaze powder as fuel. Key potions: golden carrot for night vision, magma cream for fire resistance, ghast tear for regeneration.
